optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Procurement Operations Specialist, Customer Ticketing System

professionalSummary.text: Maintains vendor contract register and renewal calendar for support product's vendors, sending renewal alerts 90 days ahead and reconciling with finance's purchase orders.
professionalSummary.witness: Maintained the vendor contract register and the renewal calendar for the support product's hosting, telephony and translation vendors, sending renewal alerts ninety days ahead and keeping the register reconciled with finance's purchase orders.

professionalSummary.text: Prepares renewal briefs including usage, spend, service credits, and benchmark prices for head of procurement's negotiations; contract values signed off by head of procurement and CFO above her limit.
professionalSummary.witness: Prepared the renewal briefs (usage, spend, service credits, benchmark prices) that the head of procurement used in renewal negotiations; contract values were signed off by the head of procurement and, above her limit, by the CFO.

professionalSummary.text: Organizes quarterly vendor reviews with service owners, circulates scorecards, and records actions; vendor exits decided by head of procurement.
professionalSummary.witness: Organised the quarterly vendor reviews with the service owners, circulating the scorecards and recording the actions; vendor exits were decided by the head of procurement.

professionalSummary.text: Updates vendor risk register quarterly from security assessments and incident notes, and documents open risks and hand-over items.
professionalSummary.witness: Updated the vendor risk register each quarter from the security team's assessments and the service owners' incident notes, and wrote the quarter-end note on open risks and hand-over items.
